dataset.name: Dresden localized prostate FFPE biopsy cohort (GSE220095)
dataset.description: Independent localized prostate cancer cohort with public bulk total-RNA sequencing from diagnostic FFPE biopsies and biochemical-recurrence follow-up after radical prostatectomy.
dataset.cohort_context: Patients underwent radical prostatectomy at University Hospital Dresden between 2007 and 2013. TRACE Explorer retains the 176 quality-controlled biopsy profiles with complete time-to-biochemical-recurrence data; this patient cohort is separate from TCGA-PRAD.

metadata.source_program: Dresden FFPE_Bx localized prostate cancer cohort
metadata.library_method: Strand-specific total RNA-seq from diagnostic FFPE prostate biopsies
metadata.redistribution_note: The GEO-processed matrix is analyzable in TRACE Explorer, but direct matrix redistribution remains disabled because GEO access alone does not resolve all submitter intellectual-property claims.
metadata.curation_note: GEO exposes one alternative sample identifier, one VST expression column and complete biochemical-recurrence follow-up for each of 176 patients. The source publication defines recurrence as PSA at least 0.2 ng/mL after radical prostatectomy. Gleason patterns are mapped deterministically to ISUP Grade Groups 1-5; pathological T categories remain descriptive and are not treated as AJCC stage groups. Twenty study-specific XLOC features lack stable GENCODE gene symbols and are not exposed as genes.

samples.sample_role: Diagnostic FFPE prostate biopsy before radical prostatectomy

expression.label: Published DESeq2 variance-stabilized counts
expression.mapping_source: Pinned GENCODE release 36 GRCh38.p12 annotation used by the source study
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Ensembl identifiers mapping to the same case-normalized gene symbol are all excluded rather than combined implicitly.
expression.scale_note: The authors adjusted HTSeq counts for library size and applied DESeq2 v1.30.1 variance-stabilizing transformation with blind=TRUE. TRACE Explorer preserves the published VST values without a second transform; their numerical scale is cohort-specific and should not be compared directly across studies.

endpoints.label: Biochemical recurrence-free survival
endpoints.event_definition: Biochemical recurrence, defined by the source study as PSA at least 0.2 ng/mL after radical prostatectomy
